blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19. USDx has one canonical deployment, Ethereum 0xa1fa7777974312f7d801a8880714a218f76233f8, with totalSupply 67,043,373.720829 USDx (18 decimals) at block 26224761 (2026-10-19T06:14:23Z): 100% of supply, so the deployment is material. The runtime resolves through the EIP-1967 implementation slot to verified USDx 0x7c4ba7477f180b0370338f722c3717b3fbfda1c6; the proxy admin slot holds 0xde4552a601e0424bdf5407b2b465d63a3df6a271 (ProxyAdmin, owner 0xd6BB04711E41aa41b9130Ad41eE6884755914c0b), so the implementation is admin-replaceable. USDx._update reverts while _paused and reverts for a blacklisted from or to; blacklist(address) and unBlacklist(address) are gated onlyRole(RESTRICTION_ROLE), pause()/unpause() onlyRole(PAUSER_ROLE), and transferFrom/burnFrom additionally reject a blacklisted spender. At block 26224761, hasRole(RESTRICTION_ROLE,0xdeb538917b1c1ae6b81550a6c42a66d818cc6d6d)=false and hasRole(PAUSER_ROLE,0xdeb538...)=false; the deployment's RoleGranted history contains no grant of either role, and paused()=false. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held by 0xdeb538917b1c1ae6b81550a6c42a66d818cc6d6d (3/3 Safe). A grantRole(RESTRICTION_ROLE,0xdeb538...) call simulated from that admin succeeds, while blacklist(...) from the admin reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount, and pause() from a random caller reverts. The active holder-targeted blacklist and pause functions therefore exist but have no assigned operator; the governance Safe can install one immediately, and the proxy admin can replace the implementation. Under the FreezeWatch decision procedure (docs/blacklist-tracker.md), this is a direct Possible, not Yes: no active holder-targeted control on the material deployment, but an admin-grantable freeze surface and an admin-upgradeable token. No declared parent; reserve composition is not determinative because a direct Possible surface is established.

oracleRisk.summary: Axis Market API supplies the RFQ terms in a user-signed order; an authorized operator accepts or rejects it and settles atomically. The contract does not independently value collateral against an external price oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: Offchain RFQ pricing determines primary-market USDx and collateral exchange amounts. USDx has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation engine requiring collateral-branch reviews. Order-signature integrity does not establish independent price discovery for settlement.

sources.label: Axis collateral valuation is not enforced by an external oracle

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Only the canonical Ethereum V2 deployment is authored. The current issuer roster states other-chain V2 tokens are not deployed; Plasma V1 remains a distinct legacy private-beta instrument. Complete token role history from deployment through Ethereum block 26197360 (2026-10-15T10:37:11Z) contains no BRIDGE_ROLE grants; the Safe retains authority to grant it without a delay.
